decision.reason: [ev-2c2bce4c1f26] names the Helm value `wireguard.userspaceFallback` as deprecated, but the values validator refuted this: it found no such key in the chart values at either compared release [ev-28e0ccb5774a] [ev-39a22d88e2f5]. Those compared releases are 1.15.6 and 1.17.0, not 1.16.0, so the evidence does not establish which values path carries the fallback switch, or whether one exists. If the key does exist, exposure should probably be the key enabled (equals true), not merely set. Setting it to false does not depend on the deprecated fallback. To decide, I need the 1.16.0 (or 1.15.x) chart values.yaml or templates that show the actual key path and its default.
